text: UK MLRs customer-due-diligence clauses are among the highest-churn obligations in the CLHEAR corpus.
MiCA CASP authorisation (Arts 59/62) is the EU crypto-services permission type; it is not a banking licence.
CLHEAR risk-v1 weights coverage deficit at 0.6, churn pressure at 0.3, and unreviewed-derived ratio at 0.1.
